findings.message: Letter is default-imported from the internal path '@konturio/default-icons/tslib/figma-icons/Letter.js', but MultivariateLegend.tsx imports it as a named export from the package root. The tslib/figma-icons layout isn't a public entry point. If the package has an `exports` map that doesn't list it, or if a version bump moves or renames the file, the import fails at build time, or at runtime gives an undefined default. Every SimpleLegend then fails to render. The fix is `import { Letter } from '@konturio/default-icons'`, which is how MultivariateLegend does it.

When a step has no 'text-color', the letter icon gets an inline `color: #000000` instead of inheriting currentColor from its parent. Take a legend step with stepShape 'letter' and no text-color, shown on a dark or themed surface. The step name text inherits the theme color, because SimpleLegendStep only sets color when text-color exists. The icon is forced to black, so it doesn't match the label and can be invisible on a dark background. Leaving out the style when text-color is unset avoids this.
